trends.topic: First-Time Homeowner Regret and Unexpected Costs
trends.raw_quote: I really regret being so trusting. First time homeowner and I just believed that the seller was being honest... A year into ownership the hvac needed replaced, a hefty expense we weren't expecting as a new homeowner.

trends.topic: Smart Home Device Frustration and Reliability
trends.raw_quote: 87% reporting that their smart home devices don't work properly. Leading the way with a score of 9.65 is Amazon as users are the most likely to consider their devices to be very unreliable or annoying.
trends.overlap_warning: NO EXISTING SKELETON - this is a fresh angle
